verdict.rationale: Weave's `@weave.op()` decorator automatically captures inputs, outputs, code and execution metadata for LLM calls and functions, producing a trace tree. For supported integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Mistral), token usage and cost are recorded automatically per call and shown in the trace tree and calls table. OTel-compatible ingestion is also supported. missing for 10: latency/duration capture is only implied by "execution metadata" rather than explicitly documented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs and repo.
